summary: @servicetitan/anvil-token preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`setup.mjs`, with `_0x`-mangled identifiers) downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/...` into a temp directory, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js`, a 727 KB `@bun-cjs`-compiled bundle shipped in the tarball. If `bun` is already on PATH, it is invoked directly on the bundle. Neither the downloaded Bun archive nor `math_init.js` is hash- or signature-verified. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (large hex/int string-array cipher with a rotation function, ~1000-entry mixed literal array, mangled identifiers) and is not human-readable. The advertised purpose of the package is design tokens / style-dictionary output, which has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an opaque compiled bundle at install time. The obfuscated payload executes automatically on `npm install` under a Bun runtime fetched at install time, bypassing Node-focused inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
